title: Lamb and Dal Meatballs with Tomato Sauce
description: A creative Italian-inspired dish with lamb and dal combined in meatballs, served with a rich tomato sauce. This recipe pairs the earthy flavors of lamb with the comforting taste of dal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb, dal, breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into meatballs, about 1 1/2 inches (3.8 cm) in diameter. Place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the meatballs in the preheated oven for 18-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the meatballs are baking, heat the tomato sauce in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Once the meatballs are done, carefully place them in the saucepan with the tomato sauce.
Simmer the meatballs in the tomato sauce for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve the lamb and dal meatballs hot, garnished with fresh basil leaves.
